claims.content: To allow a customer to place a bid on an auction item.

goal.raw_text: To allow a customer to place a bid on an auction item.

claims.content: Customer
The customer must have a registered account with JTVauctions.com.
The customer must be logged into their account.
The customer's account must be in good standing (not locked or suspended).
The customer must be viewing a Product Details Page for an item that is part of an active auction.
The auction for the item must be currently open (i.e., the current time is between the auction's start and end times).
The customer clicks the 'Place Bid' button on the Product Details Page.

trigger.raw_text: The customer clicks the 'Place Bid' button on the Product Details Page.

claims.content: The customer navigates to the Product Details Page for an item in an active auction.
The system displays the current bid, time remaining, and a 'Place Bid' button or link.
The customer clicks the 'Place Bid' button.
The system verifies that the customer is logged in. If not, it redirects them to the login page (Use Case: Login).
The system presents a bid confirmation interface, which may be a pop-up window or a section on the page, asking the customer to enter their maximum bid amount.
The customer enters their maximum bid amount, which must be higher than the current high bid and meet any predefined bid increments.
The customer confirms their bid by clicking a 'Confirm Bid' or similar button.
The system validates the bid amount against the current high bid and bid increment rules.
The system checks if the customer has a valid payment method on file. If not, it prompts them to add one before proceeding.
Upon successful validation, the system places the bid on behalf of the customer.
The system updates the Product Details Page to reflect the new high bid and identifies the customer as the current high bidder.
The system displays a confirmation message to the customer, indicating their bid was successfully placed and showing their current standing (e.g., 'You are the high bidder').
